run_sim_preprocess: run the sim_preprocess CLI to build GNN datasets from assembly files
load_graphs: load assembly files from a directory and build graphs for each problem solution
build_vocab: build a vocabulary from training set graph nodes with minimum frequency filtering
preprocess_dataset: preprocess graph datasets by converting nodes and edges to numpy arrays using a vocabulary
build_graph: recursively build a graph with nodes and edges from a tree of assembly nodes
